search: search PubMed for papers on a topic
article_details: abstract, authors, metrics of a given PMID
citation_network: papers citing or related to an article
fulltext: full text, figures, text mining of an article
export: export citations to BibTeX, RIS; save notes
compound: look up a chemical compound or drug
chronicle: research chronicle of a topic over time
institutional: library access to full text via resolver
icd: convert ICD codes and MeSH terms
pipeline: saved search pipeline: save, list, schedule
